drift_review.outcome: Section 52 adds ten declaration-layer clauses that publish the application-native directory contract the environment section deferred. Two independent review rounds drove seven normative repairs: a live issuance is identified by a registry-minted issuance identity, not by declaration fields, so a second registry that declares the same issuer identity still cannot adopt another registry handle; declared paths must be the path admitted under the declaring mapping; native path text is explicitly not a GNT-47.2 value and neither relaxes nor extends it; settlement retires the live issuance rather than the handle value, so a refused late presentation leaves the same handle routable and settleable once; the slot independently declares subject facts, and both issuance and completion compare them; and native-dir-requirement-mismatch is owned by the clause that defines it. GNT-2.1 registers the new identifiers, GNT-49.1 cites the section that supplies its deferred contract, and the conformance records that pin the specification revision and artifact digests were recut to the candidate bytes without changing any unrelated verdict.

section14_review.outcome: Every retained Section 14 excerpt is still covered with executable evidence; the revision adds no excerpt and removes none.
